productConcept.name: FIELDSET
productConcept.description: An independent quarterly publication for working engineers — post-mortems, RFC drafts, infrastructure notes, and architecture decisions published as structured documents.
productConcept.rationale: The dense-column design system is a brutalist editorial platform: 6-column newspaper broadsheet grid, Anton 160px display type, Space Mono body, zero motion, 8px nav border. The newspaper aesthetic demanded a publication, not a product. FIELDSET treats software engineering as a discipline with a written record — post-mortems, ADRs, RFC drafts published as primary sources. The Anton + Space Mono pairing (display vs monospace, 11× size gap) maps precisely to the engineering writer's world: headlines that declare, terminal type that records. Avoided the obvious (tech blog, SaaS tool dashboard) in favor of a form that earns the broadsheet grid: an actual publication with an actual archive.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — ALL durations 0s, step-start easing, explicitly stated as Anti-Animation as ideology. No GSAP, no ScrollTrigger. Instant state changes only. Ticker tape animation is the sole CSS keyframe (scrolling text band), preserved as functional UX rather than decorative motion.

index: stats — 4-column equal grid with collapsed borders
features — horizontal row list (3fr/2fr/1fr), distinct from issues grid
editorial — 2fr/1fr bento with tall left span card + 2 stacked right cards
gridVariety.features: Numbered step rows (48px number prefix + content + link — 3-column grid) — distinct from all index grids
gridVariety.archive: Full-width 5-column index table (issue num / title / date / doc count / link)
about: 3-column dark standards grid (8 cards with collapsed borders)

assetGenerationStatus: ⛔ skipped — caller instruction: skip asset generation — do not run Steps 7–8. Video tags (editorial-process.mp4, platform-in-use.mp4, typographic-specimen.mp4) are present with onerror handlers. Asset 404s are expected and handled gracefully.

qaResults.errors: Only expected 404s for video assets (3 total) — not generated per instruction. No JS errors. No CSS errors. All 5 nav links resolve correctly. Active nav states verified on all pages.

designSystemCompliance.typography: Anton 400 at clamp(72px–160px) for H1; Anton at 100px/64px/40px for H2/H3/H4; Space Mono 400 at 13–14px for all body. Correct.
designSystemCompliance.colors: #ffffff page bg, #1d1d1f near-black text, #0071e3 blue CTA, #e30000 accent red (active nav), #ffe045 not used (no appropriate context). Correct.
designSystemCompliance.motion: Zero motion: all transitions none/0s. step-start on all interactive state changes. Ticker animation is only CSS keyframe — functional scrolling band, not decorative entrance. GSAP not loaded. Correct.
designSystemCompliance.grid: 6-column broadsheet, 16px gaps, 1440px max-width, 16px container padding. All section containers use max-width:1440px margin:auto. Correct.
designSystemCompliance.spacing: 4px base unit throughout. Hero: 24px top. Section padding: 24px/16px. Gaps: 12px/16px. CTA buttons: 4px/8px. Correct.
designSystemCompliance.nav: 80px height, 8px border-bottom #1d1d1f, Anton uppercase 1rem 0.05em tracking, fixed position, instant hover flip. Active: red #e30000 opacity 0.45. Correct.
designSystemCompliance.interactions: All hover states instant (transition:none). Ghost button inverts black/white. Primary CTA inverts blue/white. Active nav: red. Focus: 3px solid black. Correct.
